statusRule: GO only when every gate with blocking=true is READY.

gates.name: Core SaaS product and tenant isolation
gates.note: Multi-tenant roles, subscription enforcement and organization provisioning are implemented and regression-tested.

gates.name: QA, staging and production stability
gates.note: Protected CI, nightly seven-role staging QA and production operating controls are present.

gates.name: Client onboarding and implementation
gates.note: Provisioning, readiness, migration/UAT and handover procedures are defined and dry-run tested.

gates.name: Commercial packaging, pricing and billing controls
gates.note: Launch plans, pricing, limits, billing and discount guardrails are controlled.

gates.name: Sales and legal contract templates
gates.note: Proposal, order form, SaaS agreement, SOW, SLA, DPA, privacy, AUP, exit, security and handover templates exist.

gates.name: Lead generation and conversion system
gates.note: Dedicated platform B2B pipeline, lead capture, qualification, follow-up and conversion controls are implemented.

gates.name: Monitoring and incident operations
gates.note: Off-host monitoring, worker health, operational metrics, backup freshness health and incident response are implemented.

gates.name: Off-site backup and disaster-recovery evidence
gates.note: Cloudflare R2 scheduled backups, off-site retrieval/checksum integrity, isolated PostgreSQL and file restore, representative record validation, measured core restore time, and cleanup were verified on 6 October 2026. Contractual RPO/RTO remains subject to separate approval.

gates.name: Verified corporate/legal execution particulars
gates.nextAction: Send the prepared counsel review pack to qualified Indian counsel, record the review outcome and required amendments in docs/legal-sales/COUNSEL_APPROVAL_RECORD.md, implement any required changes, obtain any needed re-confirmation, and only then mark legal-execution READY.
gates.note: Corporate particulars and operational contacts are verified. The internal approval-record workflow is prepared, but the gate remains blocked until an external Indian advocate/law firm completes review and approval.

gates.name: Public Privacy/Terms/AUP publication
gates.nextAction: After Indian counsel approval, set LEGAL_EFFECTIVE_DATE and LEGAL_PAGES_PUBLISHED=true, verify Privacy/Terms/AUP pages plus demo-form/footer links in staging, then publish through the normal deployment process.
gates.note: Privacy, SaaS Terms and Acceptable Use routes plus footer/demo-form links are implementation-prepared behind a publication flag. They remain disabled and the gate remains PENDING_DEPENDENCY until Indian counsel approval.

gates.name: First real paying external client
gates.nextAction: Use docs/FIRST_CLIENT_GO_LIVE_EVIDENCE.md to convert one real institution through commercial acceptance, real payment/activation evidence, WON lead linkage, onboarding READY / 100%, UAT/client acceptance, production go-live and smoke validation.
gates.note: All internal Step 11 evidence controls are prepared. The gate remains externally dependent on a real paying institution; QA, demo, synthetic and internal tenants cannot satisfy it.

gates.name: Formal production release
gates.nextAction: After Step 11 is COMPLETE and every blocking gate is READY, use docs/FORMAL_COMMERCIAL_RELEASE_EVIDENCE.md to record the exact release commit/tag, management authorization, deployment evidence, smoke validation and rollback reference.
gates.note: Formal release execution remains intentionally downstream. All internal Step 12 evidence controls are prepared; do not create the commercial release/tag until the final GO gate and management authorization are complete.
